changes: No coloured edge on rounded boxes: Administration's status lines, banners, kit parts and the chosen search result show their tone by icon and tint.
Pages load faster: the Worker now runs beside its database, so each page's data no longer waits on several long round trips.
The Lending Hub and Self-Service catalogs read their data in one step instead of two.
Staff pages no longer animate while idle: the rail's glint and the breathing status dot are gone, so scrolling and page changes stay smooth.
